description: This file contains the Catalan localization for the Select2 plugin, providing translations for various user interface messages.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message shown when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the number of characters to remove when input exceeds maximum.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting user to input more characters when input is below minimum.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message shown when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown while searching is in progress.
